question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this Wave 2+ modular dashboard roadmap as bundled Control UI/plugin work, and which subitems should be redirected to plugin SDK or ClawHub paths?
rationale: The roadmap is aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it crosses bundled plugin scope, browser sandboxing, persisted state, command binding, install-from-URL, and skill-distribution boundaries that automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Sponsor Staged Dashboard Work
options.body: Keep the umbrella open and review the linked subissues and PRs in dependency order with explicit storage, sandbox, and security approval gates.

options.title: Narrow To Extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and route optional widgets, skills, and galleries to ClawHub or external plugin packages.

options.title: Pause This Product Direction
options.body: Defer the roadmap if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard work in the current product cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Staged Dashboard Work
recommendation.body: Keep the umbrella open and review the linked subissues and PRs in dependency order with explicit storage, sandbox, and security approval gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the merged Logbook plugin-tab seam that the proposed dashboard architecture reuses.
